data.name: User becomes eligible for fraud evaluation after completing n active months

stepsWithExpectedResults.description: the system groups claims into active claiming months
stepsWithExpectedResults.expectedResult: the participant should have 4 active months: Jan, Feb, Jun, Aug. the participant should be eligible for fraud evaluation only from Aug onwards

customFields.pre_conditions: the system requires 3 active months for median calculation. a participant has claims on "10 Jan", "21 Jan", "2 Feb", "16 Jun", "19 Jun", and "21 Aug"
